{{Lang|Jiye|zh= 既夜}} is an NPC found in {{Location|Hongzhen}}. 

==Profile==
Jiye and [[Jichen]] are former Hongzhen town guardians. Although their services are no longer needed, they still watch over the now peaceful Hongzhen. 

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Daytime sitting downstairs from the Inn)
:'''The old man seems to be napping. Best not to disturb him.'''
----
;(Midnight till Morning, on the rooftop)
:'''The old man is watching every passerby with sharp eyes.
----
;(On the rooftop on top of the Souvenir Shop with Jichen)
:'''Jichen:''' Nothing suspicious happened last night, right?
:'''Jiye:''' Everything's fine...
:'''Jiye:''' You?
:'''Jichen:''' Same old, same old for the both of us.
:'''Jichen:''' Say, since the [[Midnight Rangers]] are here, shouldn't we retire?
:'''Jiye:''' ...
:'''Jichen:''' Look at you with that stubborn temper of yours. I was just spewing random thoughts. Why are you taking it so seriously?
:'''Jiye:''' ...
:'''Jichen:''' Sigh. You know, the future of Hongzhen is in young people's hands. It's time we let it go.
{{Dialogue End}}
